name: Push level test
protocol: Start at the push level you think is easy. Do one set of as many good-form reps as you can. If you reach the cap, rest 2 min and try the next level. Maximum 3 attempts.
record: Hardest level with 8+ good reps and the reps you got

name: Pull level test
protocol: Same as the push test using the pull ladder. Use the no-bar track unless you have a pull-up bar.
record: Hardest level with 8+ good reps and the reps you got

name: Squat level test
protocol: Same as the push test using the squat ladder. For one-leg levels, test your weaker side.
record: Hardest level with 8+ good reps and the reps you got

name: Hinge level test
protocol: Same as the push test using the hinge ladder. Hinge moves are easier, so the cap is 20.
record: Hardest level with 8+ good reps and the reps you got

name: Forearm plank hold
protocol: Hold a forearm plank with good form. Stop when your hips sag or pike. Under 20 s: start core at Dead Bug. 20-45 s: start at Forearm Plank. Over 45 s: try Tuck Hollow Hold.

name: Side plank hold
protocol: Hold a knee side plank (or full side plank if easy) on each side. Under 30 s: start at Knee Side Plank. 30 s or more on a full side plank: start at Side Plank.
record: Seconds held per side and which version

name: Deep squat check
protocol: Squat as low as is comfortable with heels down and hold 20 s.

name: Toe-touch reach
protocol: Stand tall, knees straight, slowly reach toward your toes. Do not bounce.
record: Reached: knees / shins / ankles / toes / floor

name: Overhead wall reach
protocol: Stand with back, head and heels against a wall. Raise straight arms overhead without arching your back.
record: Thumbs touch the wall? yes / no
